verdict.rationale: Inspecting past executions is evidenced. A hands-on community report says n8n keeps all historical executions with per-node input and output data, and the pricing page lists 'Execution search'. Nothing in the pack shows re-running a failed execution or resuming from the failing step; error workflows are a different capability (responding to failures). missing for 10: documented re-run/retry of failed executions, resume-from-failing-step capability, first-party docs on execution log inspection.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step

citations.quote: It keeps all the historical executions so you can see what happened when workflows failed and what data was going in/out of each component.
